rois.label: A
rois.boundary_note: Closed printed A-field envelope retraced from its connected source-ink perimeter at 4-pixel-per-point rendering; internal label retained. The former top edge cut across white tissue and the left edge drifted from the printed line. Thin surface-projection lines are excluded.
rois.tracing_method: Connected printed contour isolated, filled and simplified at 0.75 source pixel; enlarged source overlay checked. Boundary follows the outer source stroke within approximately one pixel.
